statuses.gate: Runs from a Git checkout plus npm ci, and must pass before every commit.
statuses.needs-assets: Needs the Git-ignored runtime assets under public/ (the asset archive).
statuses.needs-cache: Needs the ignored research inputs under .cache/.
statuses.historical: Compares against a fixed Git revision; needs full history.
statuses.known-failure: Fails on purpose until the linked open item is fixed.
statuses.stale: Already failing at V30; asserts superseded behaviour. Fix or delete, do not gate.
statuses.tool: A measurement or export script, not a pass/fail check.
